predecessors.name: Later Liang
predecessors.text: Yiwu round Dingzhou, held by Wang Chuzhi from 900 and made a principality (Prince of Beiping) by Zhu Wen in 907

successors.name: Later Tang
successors.text: Ding Prefecture (Dingzhou), whose gates Wang Du's officer Ma Rangneng opened to the Later Tang in early 929

wars.name: Battle of Boxiang (911)
wars.outcome: Wang Chuzhi's army helped crush the Later Liang forces in spring 911; Liu Shouguang's Yan attacked Yiwu in the winter of 911.

wars.name: Later Tang campaign against Wang Du
wars.outcome: Later Tang forces besieged Wang Du in 928-929; Ma Rangneng opened the gates of Dingzhou in early 929 and Wang Du killed himself.

certainty.note: Circuit frontiers, no line on the page.
